This distribution embeds an RT_MANIFEST resource (ID 1, language 0x0409)
with activeCodePage=UTF-8 for Unicode filesystem paths on Windows 10
version 1903 and newer. The original sections, imported functions,
entry point and native instructions are unchanged. The Linux Needle
binary is the unmodified upstream binary.
